about.title: About
about.caption: Dedicated to that lime-orange summer of 2026 — the color of summer, the taste of memories.
about.app_desc: EFMI Mod Manager is a Windows PC Mod Manager built with customtkinter. It enables or disables mods by moving mod folders between the Mods and Disabled_Mods directories.
about.disclaimer: EFMI Mod Manager does not load, parse, or inject mods. Mod loading is handled by EFMI at game startup; this program is only a graphical frontend that moves mod folders to control which mods are loaded.
about.credits_intro: This software includes the following third-party open source components:
about.credits_footer: Full license texts are included with this program in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt (click a project name to open its repository).
